description:

The initial contract period was from 1st December 2022 to 30th November 2025, with an option to extend the contract for a further 12 months. However due to delays in both the process of signing off the award within the Council and exchanging contract documentation between the successful bidder and the Council. description:

\r
The Bury Adult Social Care Housing with Additional Needs Market Position Statement projects an additional 86 supported living units are required to provide mental health provision by 2025. \r

A Mental Health Housing Group has been established to progress this work, with colleagues from health and social care teams and the housing growth and infrastructure team, providing valuable knowledge and insight.\r
\r
Commissioners have worked with developers and are seeking a care provider for a new mental health supported living scheme that is focused on delivering positive outcomes for Bury people.  \r
\r
The property provides 14 self-contained apartments over 2 floors.  The developer is St David Group and the Registered Housing Provider is Inclusion Homes. The property is newly developed.\r
\r
The supported living service required is for 24/7 supported accommodation with specialist skills to support people with their mental health recovery.\r
